stories.title: 75% of Charlotte-area households priced out of median-priced home, report finds
stories.summary: The findings come from the State of Housing in Charlotte report, published by the Childress Klein Center for Real Estate.

stories.title: Nearly 40 acres near Charlotte airport could become a destination district, but hurdles remain
stories.summary: The nearly 40-acre proposal would bring hotels, restaurants and other businesses across from Charlotte Douglas International Airport.

stories.title: Man threatened to kill cousin during Thanksgiving argument before shooting into SUV, CMPD says
stories.summary: An affidavit says John McMillian threatened to shoot his cousin during an argument before opening fire on the SUV, striking a 50-year-old woman multiple times.

stories.title: NC Board of Education issues expectations to CMS amid leadership concerns
stories.summary: State leaders say in the letter that these actions will "strengthen governance functions and position the district for long-term success."

stories.title: Give Local campaign raises nearly $400,000 for nonprofits in Lancaster, Chester counies
stories.summary: "That's what it's all about. Really making sure that we take care of each other."

stories.title: Dry for now and warming up leading into weekend
stories.summary: Charlotte stays dry through Friday as temperatures climb. A chance of light rain returns this weekend, with the best window from Friday night through early Sunday.

stories.title: City of Charlotte seeks dismissal of Iryna Zarutska wrongful death lawsuit
stories.summary: Charlotte's dismissal filing claims the city has governmental immunity and that it is protected by the public-duty doctrine.

stories.title: City of Charlotte settles unlawful force suit stemming from June 2020 protests for $1.7M
stories.summary: Plaintiffs argued that once police "kettled" protesters in, officers deployed force, including tear gas and stinger grenades, despite no immediate threat.

stories.title: Mooresville school to remain closed for mold cleanup, district says
stories.summary: Coddle Creek Elementary will be closed to students this week, as Iredell-Statesville Schools approved a new mold cleanup contract on Monday.

stories.title: Charlotte City Council moves forward with working group to guide $300M in I-77 toll lane benefits
stories.summary: The state has promised $300 million to support community benefits in impacted neighborhoods.

stories.title: Possible measles exposure at Hickory church, pediatric office
stories.summary: Folks who visited St. Aloysius Catholic Church on Sunday, Nov. 1 or Unifour Pediatrics PA on Nov. 5 should be wary of measles symptoms and check their vaccination.

stories.title: Charlotte husband forgives driver accused in crash that killed his wife, injured children
stories.summary: After losing his wife in a crash involving an 18-year-old driver, Thomas Barringer embraces forgiveness over anger.
